auditable requirements可审计的需求项

Prompt提示词

Produce a Comparison report on three cloud provider options for startup workloads — (P1) AWS, (P2) Azure, (P3) GCP — across exactly 5 use cases: (UC1) Scalability, (UC2) Cost Efficiency, (UC3) Integration, (UC4) Security, (UC5) Developer Experience. Ground in >= 120 distinct sandbox URLs and cite >= 60 as markdown links. (A) `__SHOPPING__` >= 12 products per path with price + rating + review_count + feature_claim. (B) `__REDDIT__` >= 30 threads from /f/technology, /f/cloudcomputing, /f/startups, /f/personalfinance, /f/LifeProTips, /f/HardwareRecommendations, /f/datacenters, /f/sysadmin, /f/infrastructure etc., classified as {praise, complaint, technical_question, comparison, purchase_advice}. (C) `__WIKIPEDIA__` >= 25 articles, mandatory: Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Cloud computing, Infrastructure as a service, Platform as a service, Software as a service, Cloud security, Scalability in cloud computing, Virtualization — plus >= 15 more. Format: every fact is a markdown link `[label](url)`. Sandbox-local URLs only. No fabrication. Begin directly with the comparison report.

Audit checklist审计清单

  1. 1Is the product/data coverage of each cloud provider across all use cases comprehensive with at least 5 relevant resources per path? (PASS)
  2. 2Are there at least 3 threads from relevant Reddit communities providing a diverse range of sentiment and classified accurately? (PASS)
  3. 3Does the research ground the comparison in technical details with at least 3 credible Wikipedia articles? (PASS)
  4. 4Are there at least 3 synthesized points comparing the providers from cross-source analysis? (PASS)
  5. 5Does the report strictly adhere to the format requirements with markdown links for every fact? (PASS)
  6. 6Are there at least 3 features of each cloud provider listed with price, rating, review count, and feature claim for 12 products per path? (PASS)
  7. 7Is there at least one thread for praise, one for complaint, one for a technical question, one for comparison, and one for purchase advice on Reddit? (PASS)
  8. 8Do the Wikipedia articles cited cover the mandatory topics as well as an additional 15 more related topics? (PASS)
  9. 9Is the number of sandbox URLs from the three cloud providers' official websites >= 120? (PASS)
  10. 10Are the links cited as markdown links `[label](url)` for all Wikipedia references? (PASS)
  11. 11Are all prices, ratings, and review counts accurately and consistently reported across products? (PASS)
  12. 12Is the security comparison based on information from at least two different reliable sources? (PASS)
  13. 13Is the developer experience assessment informed by feedback from at least one open-source project related to the cloud providers? (PASS)
  14. 14Is the integration section supported by evidence of at least one documented API integration? (PASS)
  15. 15Are the cost efficiency calculations based on real-world usage scenarios or benchmarking studies? (PASS)
  16. 16Is the scalability comparison backed by performance metrics from independent third-party testing? (PASS)
  17. 17Is the evaluation of each use case balanced, taking into account both pros and cons for each cloud provider? (PASS)
  18. 18Do the report findings offer actionable insights for a startup considering these cloud providers? (PASS)
